content: PDF options: CSS print styles let browsers save a rendered resume as PDF with low implementation overhead; if the product requires a direct download button and deterministic A4 pagination, @react-pdf/renderer 4.9.0 supports browser download via PDFDownloadLink and custom embedded TTF/WOFF fonts. Use static Cyrillic-capable font files and test Cyrillic glyphs, wrapping, and page breaks. Source: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Guides/Media_queries/Printing https://react-pdf.org/docs/v4/advanced/on-the-fly-rendering https://react-pdf.org/docs/v4/fonts https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40react-pdf/renderer
